subject: Release memo — f00tils 0.16.7
ref: CHANGELOG.md, scripts/render-brand-assets.py, site Feature tour, v0.16.6 surface

Regenerated forced-color PTY screenshots that demonstrate real features (ls, grep, diff, cat, find, multicall tour), added the Feature tour on https://coreutils.f00.sh, and codified screenshot regen as a mandatory release step in the operator SOP.
